title: 60% off 3kg of Inglewood Coffee - $84
body:
Deal: 60% off 3kg of Inglewood Coffee - $84

[xxJAGUARxx] I tried their single origins absolute trash. The normal blends are okay
[Onemoredeal] What is the high altitude African one really lightly roasted? I also tried that last time and wasn’t that keen. I did some google research and it’s intentionally lightly roasted but lacks the oils of the more traditional espresso so comes out like dirty water with no creama which it’s supposed to do apparently. Anyway I’ll not get it again but love the blends
[Savealopoulos] Doubt it, have tried dozens of their single origins. Some misses but lots of hits. No trash, not even once.
[xxJAGUARxx] Freeze em bras! But yeab get LimeBlue these guys are meh
[Daabido] The ladies do like to keep them cool in summer.
[iMagoo] Run by a bunch of flogs, don’t give them business. Their specialty coffee spin off goes out of their way to slag other businesses in the industry, making false claims along the way:
https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dcz5slqT3NG
Debunked by Scott Rao (known as a legend of coffee roasting):
https://www.instagram.com/p/DdqgXfrCjpN
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dd07Q_XCrxT
Another post trashing on other businesses and getting backlash from big names in the comments:
https://www.instagram.com/reel/Ddn25_WBFV8
All in all, not a good look and I hope it damages their Inglewood brand too.
[Chocobros] Never got round to trying inglewood as always had a good supply of lime Blue but it was on my to do list. Probably won't bother now
[Nivlac] From my experience, I’ve tried Inglewood’s filter blends a couple of times, but nothing stood out. At first, I thought my first order might have been a dud, so I gave them another chance with a second order but I had the same underwhelming experience.
After reading iMagoo's comment and watching a few of the founder's interviews, I'm so glad i didn't stuck around with them.
[boozed] So what you're saying is that this stuff is probably more fit for other uses
